name: NG exhaustion aftermath post-end transition checkpoint freeze
scope: Target 2 causal refinement only; runway clock and permanent Frankie remain untouchable
reason: The exploratory +41..+60 late-flow split is not causal for fast-collapse price aftermath when the dynamic exhaustion endpoint occurs before +41. This freeze replaces any backward-looking use of +60 with endpoint-relative features.

dynamic_endpoint.primary_anchor: causal confirmation second of the first 3-second oriented roll20 <= 0 termination run

immediate_aftermath_lane.purpose: Describe raw tape beginning at the confirmed exhaustion endpoint without future-state leakage.
immediate_aftermath_lane.forbidden: No feature observed after the endpoint may be used to explain or predict a price interval that begins at the endpoint.

transition_checkpoint_lane.purpose: Observe whether the market reloads or reverses after exhaustion has actually ended, then predict only tape that remains in the future.
transition_checkpoint_lane.why_20: One full native roll20 window after the dynamic endpoint; chosen from signal mechanics before holdout scoring, not from price outcomes.
features_available_by_checkpoint: oriented aggressor-volume pressure over endpoint+1 through endpoint+20
aligned book change endpoint to checkpoint

primary_flow_state.sparse_or_balanced: no classified aggressor volume or exactly balanced pressure

transition_checkpoint_lane.primary_thresholding: sign only; no held-out-optimized magnitude cut
transition_checkpoint_lane.secondary_bins: quintile/decile cutpoints derived from reveal only and applied unchanged to holdout

interpretation_guardrail: A strong endpoint+20 transition-state result is a delayed aftermath update, not evidence that the same state was knowable at the exhaustion endpoint.
chain_relationship: If validated, the endpoint-relative transition state becomes a candidate link descriptor for later week-continuous chain research; it does not itself define chain membership or reset.
